name: mosfet_3d
description: M19 capstone: 3D n-channel MOSFET on a gmsh-sourced unstructured tetrahedral mesh (fixtures/mosfet3d.msh, ~26k nodes / ~75k coupled DOFs at cl = 20 nm; regenerate at finer cl via benchmarks/mosfet_3d/generate_mesh.py for the ~200k / ~500k-DOF targets). P-type Si body (1 um x 1 um x 200 nm, N_A = 1e16 cm^-3) with a 5 nm SiO2 gate oxide over the full top footprint. n+ source and drain are the two x-end faces of the silicon, Gaussian-implanted (peak 5e19 cm^-3). The channel-direction implant sigma is 90 nm (rescaled from the 400 nm starter-prompt nominal so the 1 um body retains a ~250 nm p-type channel; the nominal 400 nm sigma would counter-dope the whole body). Lombardi composite surface mobility (M16.2) on a Caughey-Thomas velocity-saturation bulk branch (M16.1). Fermi-Dirac / Blakemore statistics (M16.4) for the n+ regions. Gate sweeps V_GS = 0 to 2.0 V at V_DS = 0.05 V (linear regime). GPU-capable linear solver via solver.backend = auto (resolves to cpu-mumps when no GPU is present). Drain current is verified within +-25% of the Pao-Sah long-channel analytical reference over [V_T + 0.2, V_T + 0.8] V.
